sloka: स मे हरिश्रेष्ठ सलक्ष्मणं पतिं सयूथपं क्षिप्रमिहोपपादय ।चिराय रामं प्रति शोककर्शितां कुरुष्व मां वानरमुख्य हर्षिताम् ।। ५.३७.६६।।
transliteration: sa me hariśreṣṭha salakṣmaṇaṁ patiṁ sayūthapaṁ kṣipramihopapādaya ।cirāya rāmaṁ prati śokakarśitāṁ kuruṣva māṁ vānaramukhya harṣitām ।। 5.37.66।।

translations.english: "O chief of vanaras who can withstand Rama accompanied by Lakshmana, the conqueror of enemies? His arrows resemble the rays of the Sun at the time of the deluge, steady like the elephants who support the quarters of the earth.
